title: Pain to change batteries and filter.
text: Pain to change batteries and filter.. Pretty but not user friendly at all. To change out filter you must remove 4 tiny screws and there are more bits and pieces that come off with it. After you take apart you still need to remove cover to filter that feels so fragile your afraid to break it. Nowto get to the batteries you must first remove the filter above because it's compartment is underneath the filter. One would probably end up giving up using the filter. Then the battery compartment cap is so hard to get off as well. Be sure you buy 4 "D" batteries if you order it, because that is what it requires to work and does not come with any. Who buysD batteries any more!?! Youwill be doing so if you get this garbage can. It's pretty but really wanted taller and o thinner.to fit space ideally.
